summary: Defines SNMP managed objects for DS1, E1, DS2 and E2 interfaces, which are standard telephone-style digital line types. It is a companion to documents for DS0, DS3/E3 and synchronous optical interfaces. It was replaced by RFC 4805.

eli5.summary: Phone-style data lines have meters that show their health. This document defines the meters. It was replaced by RFC 4805.

questions: snmp management of t1 e1 interfaces
